API Gateway Request Tampering [Tampering, Spoofing, CWE-345] on APIGateway, Mobile Client, Game Logic Lambda: Attackers could use man-in-the-middle techniques to intercept API calls, modify request payloads, or replay captured requests to manipulate game outcomes. An attacker uses a proxy tool to intercept game action requests, modifies the score data before it reaches the server, and injects falsified game achievements.

Cognito Authentication Bypass [Spoofing, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-287] on Cognito, APIGateway, Mobile Client: Attackers might attempt to forge JWT tokens, steal valid tokens through XSS attacks, or exploit token handling vulnerabilities in the client application. An attacker captures a valid JWT token through a compromised device or XSS vulnerability, then uses it to make unauthorized API calls on behalf of the victim.

DDoS Attack on CDN [Denial of Service, CWE-400] on CloudFront, S3, Mobile Client: Attackers could overwhelm the CDN with a large volume of requests, consuming bandwidth and processing resources, leading to service degradation or unavailability. A botnet is used to generate massive amounts of requests to the CloudFront distribution, preventing legitimate users from downloading game assets.

DynamoDB Injection Attacks [Tampering, Information Disclosure, CWE-943] on DynamoDB, Game Logic Lambda, Score Processor Lambda, Leaderboard Manager Lambda: Attackers could exploit poorly sanitized input in DynamoDB queries to manipulate query logic and access or modify unauthorized data. An attacker injects malicious expressions into game state queries, allowing them to access or modify other players' data.

Game Logic Exploitation [Tampering, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-841] on Game Logic Lambda, Score Processor Lambda, DynamoDB: Attackers could exploit logic flaws, race conditions, or input validation issues in game logic to manipulate game outcomes. A player discovers a way to submit impossible scores by manipulating the game logic function's input parameters.

Leaderboard Race Conditions [Tampering, Information Disclosure, CWE-362] on Leaderboard Manager Lambda, DynamoDB, ElastiCache: Concurrent updates to leaderboard data could lead to race conditions where the final state becomes inconsistent or can be manipulated. Multiple simultaneous score updates cause a race condition that allows a player to submit multiple high scores for the same game session.

Analytics Data Exposure [Information Disclosure, Tampering, CWE-200] on Kinesis Data Streams, Kinesis Data Analytics, SNS: Insufficient access controls or misconfigured IAM policies could allow unauthorized access to analytics data streams. An attacker exploits overly permissive IAM roles to access Kinesis streams and extract sensitive user behavior data.

Insufficient Game Action Logging [Repudiation, CWE-778] on Game Logic Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch: Lack of comprehensive logging could prevent detection and investigation of suspicious game activities. A player uses automated tools to play the game, but the behavior goes undetected due to insufficient logging.
